Developers can build for mobile, web, and desktop using hot reload for rapid iteration, making it ideal for startups and teams needing efficient cross-platform development with consistent user experiences.

summaries.en: React Native is an open-source framework that enables developers to build truly native mobile apps for iOS and Android using JavaScript and React, solving the challenge of maintaining separate codebases for different platforms. Its core innovation bridges JavaScript with native platform APIs through an asynchronous bridge architecture, allowing UI components to render as native views rather than web views. summaries.zh: Vue 是一个渐进式 JavaScript 框架，专门用于构建用户界面，它通过温和的学习曲线解决了现代前端开发的复杂性挑战。框架的核心在于响应式数据绑定和组件化架构——当数据变化时，视图会自动更新，而组件系统让复杂界面可以拆分为独立可复用的单元。开发者可以从现有项目逐步引入 Vue，使用 Vue Router 构建单页应用，或通过单文件组件将模板、逻辑和样式整合在一起，快速搭建复杂的交互界面。
summaries.en: Vue is a progressive JavaScript framework for building user interfaces, addressing the complexity of modern web development with an approachable learning curve. Its core innovation lies in the reactive data binding system and component-based architecture, where components automatically update when data changes. Developers can incrementally adopt Vue into existing projects, create single-page applications with Vue Router, or build complex interfaces using single-file components that combine template, logic, and styling in one file.
